clip.prompt: 10-second silent photorealistic image-to-video automotive piece: light blue and black Bugatti from @product driving across the Golden Gate Bridge from @environment, 16:9. Live-action realism, early-morning side light, calm aspirational mood, crisp paint reflections, believable asphalt, smooth unhurried driving. Use references as likeness guides, not pasted photos. Preserve @product’s exact body shape, blue-and-black paint layout, grille and wheels; discard display platform, crowd and original setting. Preserve @environment’s red-orange architecture, suspension cables, blue bay and green hills; replace midday light with morning light; omit photographed traffic and pedestrians. One continuous roadside shot; consistent car, bridge geometry, travel direction and morning light. 0–5 s: medium-wide front three-quarter view from a safe roadside position at car-window height. Bugatti, anchored by its light-blue nose and black accents, drives steadily left to right in the nearest lane. Red-orange railing borders the road; bridge towers rise in the upper background. Camera pans smoothly right, keeping the entire car visible. 5–10 s: medium-wide side-to-rear three-quarter view. Bugatti, anchored by its blue-and-black paint, continues rightward. Blue water shows through the railing below; green hills appear small on the far horizon. Roadside camera gently eases its rightward pan to a composed view. At 8 s, freeze the frame for the final two seconds, keeping the complete car and recognizable bridge readable, without another shot. Audio off. Restrained natural grade, warm highlights, clean blue shadows, measured pacing. Negatives: no captions, added lettering, spectators, display stand, studio setting, interior views, aerial views, racing, skid marks, distorted wheels, altered car identity or warped bridge cables.
